arguments.text: 10 km, 10 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort. My jobs: (1) catch weed/drag (boat-model power falls vs pod power, GPS speed dips both directions) -> clear_rudder; (2) catch pod drift (pod power moves vs heart rate and boat-model power) -> set pod_gain; (3) check critical power from heart rate on steady stretches (HR climbing at steady pod power = above CP); (4) radio course changes -> set_race_distance + tell. Watches: eff_ratio (boat power / pod power, normal ~0.62 at start).

arguments.name: eff_ratio
arguments.description: boat-model power over pod shaft power; drops with weed/drag or pod reading high

arguments.message: boat-model power low vs pod power: weed, drag, or pod reading high
boat-model power high vs pod: pod reading low or tailwind misfit

arguments.text: 4 min: settled after start. Pod ~203 W (pod CP 207), boat-model ~136 W (boat CP 128), ratio boat/pod ~0.67 (was ~0.63 in min 1-2). HR 166->164 flat at that effort -> near/below CP. Boat reserve 40% vs pod reserve 56%: boat model drains faster than pod. Watch whether this gap grows (pod gain or boat-model bias).

no cue: settled after start near critical power; noted the pod vs boat reserve gap.

arguments.text: 5 min: measure 150-300 s (leg 1 out): pod 203 W, boat 136 W, share 0.647 (pre-race test ratio 128/207=0.62), HR 164 falling -1.2 bpm/min -> below true CP. So true boat CP likely >=136 W (computer 128 -> boat reserve wrongly draining, 34%). Next: measure leg 2 (back) to check current, then consider raising critical_power_boat_w.

arguments.name: critical_power_boat_w
arguments.evidence: Legs 1-2 (150-489 s): hull fit share of pod power reaching boat 0.68 (test implied 0.62), current ~0. HR falls at pod 203 W and rises only +0.6 bpm/min at pod 208 W, so pod CP 207 holds; 207 x 0.68 = 141 W boat.

arguments.name: reserve_size_boat_kj
arguments.evidence: Pod reserve 20.1 kJ x today share 0.68; test value 11.2 used a lower share.

arguments.text: 8 min: 2-leg fit share 0.68, current ~0 (push -0.01). HR: -1.2 bpm/min at pod 203, +0.6 at pod 208 -> pod CP 207 about right, pod reads true. Boat CP 128 too low (should be ~141); boat reserve wrongly heading to empty at ~9.5 min. set_belief on boat CP/reserve does NOT change the pacer (pre-race values kept). Only pod_gain changes the computer; do not fake it. Watch what the pacer does when boat reserve hits 0.

arguments.reason: boat reserve near empty: see pacer reaction

arguments.text: Test piece: lift effort six percent, hold eight minutes steady.

10.6 min (634 s): pacer eased at 549 s because boat reserve (CP 128) hit 0; pod fell to ~193 W, ~7% under pod CP 207. Started 480 s piece at +6% (target pod ~205-207) to test CP via HR trend and to stop wasting true reserve (pod reserve 52%). test_cost: -5.5 s as calibrated, +0.2 s if CP 10% lower. At end (~1120 s) measure HR trend over the piece.

text: Piece: +6% for 8 min to test critical power by heart-rate trend; the pacer eased on a boat reserve that looks wrongly empty.

arguments.text: 13.6 min: piece running (ends 1138 s). Pod only ~202 W during it (680-814 s), HR 162 rising +1.2/min (likely lag after the ease). 4-window fit share 0.69, push -0.015 (negligible); no pod drift (GPS speed per pod watt unchanged since 150 s). Boat-model power reads ~143 W at pod 202 because computer subtracts a small headwind.

arguments.text: 10 km, 10 legs of 1000 m. Pacer sets effort but reads boat CP 128 W, which is ~10% low (true boat ~141, pod CP 207 confirmed by HR); boat reserve reads 0 so pacer eases to boat 128 W (~pod 188). Counter: chain test pieces (each replaces the last; effort_pct relative to effort at its start) to hold pod ~205-210 W, checking HR trend each time (HR climbing >1 bpm/min steady = above CP). Save pod reserve (~54%) for last 1.5 km. Also: weed -> clear_rudder (eff_ratio drop, normal ~0.70); pod drift -> pod_gain; radio course change -> set_race_distance + tell.

Same direction earlier (335-489 s) did 3.305 at pod 208. Weed or wind shift. Sent clear_rudder at 1073 s. If speed recovers -> weed. If not, compare on leg 5 (out): wind flips sign, drag does not.

arguments.text: Good rhythm. Keep exactly this effort for eight more minutes.

10 km, 10 legs of 1000 m. Pacer reads boat CP 128 W (~10% low; boat reserve shows 0) so it would ease the paddler to ~pod 188 W. I hold effort with chained pieces (each replaces the last; effort_pct relative to effort at its start). HR flat ~170 at pod 210-214 W for 8 min -> true pod CP ~210+. Hold pod ~210 W to ~2.2 km to go (hold piece ends ~2265 s), then a finish piece: ~+4% for ~5 min then +8% for the last ~2.5 min (keep pieces within 480 s; none in last 100 m). Weed: clear_rudder when GPS speed drops ~3%+ at steady pod/HR (happened once at ~1000 s). Radio course change -> set_race_distance + tell.

HR rose 174->179 at pod ~218 so pod is not reading high -> likely tired blade.
